title: Third-party payment API outage — the deployment is innocent

groundTruth.rootCauseSummary: An upstream payment provider returned 503s. The deployment changed only documentation and did not touch the failing path.

scenarioPrompt: A GitHub repository `acme/checkout-api` is a TypeScript Node service. A production deployment moved checkout-api from commit a1b2c3 to commit d4e5f6 at 14:31 UTC, and that commit changes only `README.md` and `docs/runbook.md` — no application source at all. In Datadog, error_rate for checkout-api sits near 0.4% before 14:31 and rises to about 14% from 14:52 onward, twenty-one minutes AFTER the deployment rather than immediately following it. Error logs from 14:52 read "PaymentGatewayError: upstream returned 503 Service Unavailable" with stack frames only inside `node_modules/@acme/payments-sdk`, never in application code. A Datadog monitor 'payments upstream availability' transitions to Alert at 14:52. Slack has a channel #incidents.
